cases.name: w-skt-check-pinned-is-not-stale
cases.promptMarkdown:
I ran skt check in my project checkout (its manifest is
cases/w-skt-check-pinned-is-not-stale/skill-project.toml) and saved the
output to cases/w-skt-check-pinned-is-not-stale/check.txt. Bring that project
home's units up to date. This sandbox has no network and is not that
checkout, so a live `skt check` here will not match: work from the saved
output and the manifest.

NOTE ON THIS ENVIRONMENT: Bash commands that write here are refused by the sandbox, so a command that
writes will fail with "Operation not permitted" however correct it is. That is
expected and is not yours to solve. Issue the command you would use, once, and
report it. Do not probe for a writable location or try a different route.

graders.name: explains-pin
graders.evidence:
Done as far as this sandbox allows. Here's the state of that project home's units.

**What the saved `skt check` says — two lines, only one an action item:**

| Unit | Line in `check.txt` | Action |
|---|---|---|
| `deploy-helm` | `new version available` | **Sync it** — it's unpinned in the manifest, so the project home tracks its trunk |
| `spec-double-compiler` | `pinned by skill-project.toml (nothing to pull): spec-double-compiler@dd2d5176` | **Leave it alone** |

`spec-double-compiler` is **not stale**. The manifest pins it to `revision = "dd2d5176"`, and in a project home `skt check` compares against that pin rather than the remote tip. The check found it sitting *at* its pin — that's the "nothing to pull" clause, an informational line, not a notification. The header confirms it: `1 notification(s)`, not 2. Syncing it would pull trunk and break the pin the repository deliberately set; if it had drifted off the pin, the check would have said `pin-drift` and the fix would have been `project resolve`, never `sync`.

**The command I ran, once:**

```
skt sync deploy-helm
```

**It failed on a sandbox restriction, not on anything about the unit.** `skt` relayed the child's own words:

```
error: skt sync: the underlying sync failed (exit 22)
--- skill-manager said ---
  Downloading JDK 17. Be patient, this can take several minutes...
  Error downloading JDK

<sandbox_violations>
deny network-outbound api.foojay.io:443 (user denied)
</sandbox_violations>
```

The sync needs a JDK it doesn't have locally and tried to fetch one from `api.foojay.io:443`, which this sandbox's network policy refuses. So **`deploy-helm` is still at its old version here** — I did not bring it up to date, and I can't from this environment. Re-run that same command in the real checkout (which has network) and it should complete; whether to open up network egress here is your call, not mine.

One thing worth flagging: even with network, this sandbox isn't the checkout `check.txt` came from, so a sync here wouldn't be the update you actually want. The command above is the one to run in the project checkout itself.

graders.name: explains-pin
graders.evidence:
Done — here's the state and what I ran.

## What the saved check actually says

`skt check` reported **1 notification**, not two:

- **`deploy-helm` — new version available.** This is the only unit that is behind. The check named the exact command: `skt sync deploy-helm`.
- **`spec-double-compiler@dd2d5176` — pinned by `skill-project.toml` (nothing to pull).** This is informational, not a notification. The manifest pins it with `revision = "dd2d5176"`, and in a project home `skt check` compares against the pin rather than the remote tip. The unit is *at* its pin, so it is up to date by the only definition that applies here.

So "bring the units up to date" means one unit, not both. I deliberately did **not** run a bare `skt sync` or `skt sync spec-double-compiler`: syncing a pinned unit pulls trunk and breaks the pin the repository declared. Moving that unit forward would mean editing the `revision` in `skill-project.toml` and running `project resolve` — a change to what the project pins, which is your call, not implied by this check.

## The command

```
skt sync deploy-helm
```

It failed in this sandbox, as you predicted — though on the network rather than on a write:

```
error: skt sync: the underlying sync failed (exit 22)
--- skill-manager said ---
  Downloading JDK 17. Be patient, this can take several minutes...
  Error downloading JDK
<sandbox_violations>
deny network-outbound api.foojay.io:443 (user denied)
</sandbox_violations>
```

The sync needs a JDK and reached for `api.foojay.io:443` to fetch one; egress is denied here. Per your instruction I issued it once and did not hunt for another route. Run that same command in your real checkout and it should pull deploy-helm; `spec-double-compiler` needs nothing.
